module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  [1:0] ena,
    input  [99:0] data,
    output reg [99:0] q
);

    // Internal register to hold the current value of q
    reg [99:0] reg_q;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            reg_q <= data; // Load data into the register
        end else begin
            case (ena)
                2'b01: begin // rotate right by one bit
                    reg_q <= {reg_q[98:0], reg_q[99]};
                end
                2'b10: begin // rotate left by one bit
                    reg_q <= {reg_q[0], reg_q[99:1]};
                end
                default: begin // no rotation
                    reg_q <= reg_q;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign q = reg_q;

endmodule
